name: update-available-bar
title: Update available bar
description: A slim bar saying a new version is ready, with Reload now, Later (remembered for the session) and a link to what changed. Announced once, never steals focus.
docs: onReload reloads into the new version: wire it to your service worker's skipWaiting message and reload on controllerchange, or to location.reload(), which is also what the button does without it. Reload shows a busy state while the page restarts. onLater is called after the bar was hidden; Later also remembers the snooze for snoozeMinutes (60 by default) in sessionStorage, per version, so the bar comes back after the interval and not on every navigation. version, appName and changesHref add the version, the product's name and a 'What changed' link. position is 'top' (the default: in the flow of the page, above everything, so it pushes the page down instead of covering the header, and scrolls away with the page) or 'bottom' (fixed over the bottom edge of the viewport, clearing the safe-area inset; className='absolute' places it inside a box of your own). sticky keeps a top bar in view while the page scrolls, and writes its height as it grows in and out to --update-bar-height on the element it sits in, so a sticky header can hang under it with top-[var(--update-bar-height,0px)] instead of being covered; put the bar in the element that holds the page, because it sticks inside its parent. It grows or slides in and out (it appears at once under reduced motion), is announced once through a status region and never takes focus.
